topic: Smell of rain on dry soil (petrichor) — soil bacteria make geosmin; raindrops trap air bubbles that pop and fling the scent into the air
title: Pehli Boond… Aur Ye Khushboo Kahan Se? 🌧️ #shorts
title_en: First Raindrop… Where Does That Smell Come From? 🌧️ #shorts
description:
Baarish ki pehli boond girte hi mitti ki khushboo kyun aati hai?
Mitti ke andar chhupe nanhe jaraseem, hawa ke bulbule — aur aap ki naak ka kamaal.

Why does dry soil smell so good when the first rain hits? Soil bacteria make the scent, and tiny bubbles in each raindrop pop and fling it into the air.

پہلی بوند… اور یہ خوشبو کہاں سے آئی؟

description_en:
Why does dry soil smell so good when the first rain hits? Tiny soil bacteria make a scent called geosmin. When a raindrop lands, air hidden in the soil rises as tiny bubbles that pop like soda fizz and fling the scent into the air — and your nose can catch even one drop of it in a whole swimming pool.
